content.title: WH Q3 Deep Dive: Revenue Falls Short, Guidance Trimmed Amid RevPAR Weakness
content.summary: Hotel franchising company Wyndham (NYSE:WH) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 3.5% year on year to $382 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.46 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.summary: Wyndham Hotels & Resorts (WH) kept its profitability streak alive, with earnings growing by 33.6% over the past year and an average of 25.6% annually for five years. Net profit margins improved sharply to 23.6%, up from 18.3% last year, earning the company recognition for high-quality results.
